spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's user journey verbatim: track event → wrap el.track in a MediaStream, error event reading el.error (DOMException), cancel event, and monitoring of enabled/muted/ended — including the post-grant toggle that only the single-capability elements have (and why <usermedia> skips it).

interactive.rationale: Live <camera>/<microphone> slots wired to a video preview and an AnalyserNode level meter; on unsupported engines the clearly-labelled imperative rehearsal drives the identical wiring plus page toggle/stop buttons, all recorded in a live ledger.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises preview + meter + state ledger + honest fallback; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Ledger distinguishes acquisition, hardware mute/unmute, page-toggle enabled flips, and stop() — and the stop() line explicitly teaches that stop() does NOT fire the track's ended event in the stopping context (a first-draft line claiming it does was caught and corrected during verification). getUserMedia rejections surface name+message honestly.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5153829504024576 and the explainer this page's flow mirrors.

conformance.rationale: The track-surface, capture-base and single-capability-distinction assertions cover this page's wiring as self-contained checks.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP, two configurations: (1) standard launch — both rehearsal calls genuinely rejected with NotFoundError, ledgered honestly; (2) --use-fake-device-for-media-stream launch — real video track (label fake_device_0) attached to a playing <video>, real audio track drove the AnalyserNode meter to peak 1.0, page toggle flipped enabled false→true on both tracks, stop() flipped readyState to ended. Zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: capelem-toggle-lab-loaded asserts with the supported flag.

design_system.rationale: Bordered panels on ivory, stone ledger, emerald/rose only via shared vars; buttons keep the global dark style (no background override).

accessibility.rationale: Ledger is role=log aria-live with a labelling heading; meter has aria-label plus a text readout; video has aria-label; status role=status; all controls native buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Two-column grid collapses under 760px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the element's own trusted toggle on Chrome 153+
openQuestions.detail: The browser-rendered second-click toggle (and the in-page permission recovery flow) only exists where the elements ship; the enabled-flip polling that ledgers it is untested against the real element UI. Verify on a 153+ build with a camera/microphone present.

openQuestions.title: Meter behaviour under the element's toggle vs page toggle
openQuestions.detail: When the element disables the track, confirm the meter falls to 0 while readyState stays live — the rehearsal path shows this for the page toggle, but the element path should be captured too.

guidanceConsulted.query: live audio level meter canvas accessibility announce state
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair visual meters with text equivalents and use live regions for event streams.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: meter element + text readout (throttled, aria-live off to avoid flooding); ledger as role=log live region.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detect unsupported html element honest fallback banner
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce failures programmatically where the visual state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: status role=status carries every rejection with DOMException name; rehearsal panel is explicitly tagged as the imperative comparison, never the element.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): both truth paths captured for real — NotFoundError rejections on the bare sandbox, and full acquire→meter→toggle→stop lifecycle against Chromium's fake capture devices, with the meter measurably peaking and enabled flips ledgered. The stop()-fires-ended misconception was caught by this run and the copy corrected.
